input.title: [Mobile Safari] Document body is scrollable when cheatsheet is open in single tab
input.body:
**Platform**: Mobile Safari only, does not occur in Capacitor
**Settings**: Single Tab

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/afdea8bf-5b6a-451b-83fe-08aa0bf46395)

Originally reported in https://github.com/cybersemics/em/pull/2850#pullrequestreview-2727333729.

Additional observations: https://github.com/cybersemics/em/pull/2850#issuecomment-2848446447

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Refresh the page
2. Perform '?' gesture to open cheatsheet.
3. Scroll between right edge of screen and right border of cheatsheet.

## Current Behavior

Document body can be scrolled on the right edge of the screen.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f681445-38c2-4a29-bdf8-3a3e65057325

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e79f3f00-4c62-40fe-a4c5-0a8649a56cfa

## Expected Behavior

Document body should not be scrollable when cheatsheet is open.
